<article class="paper-card" id="powlu-an-activation-function-for-stable-pre-training-of-llms">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.05</span>
    <span>优化</span>
  </div>
  <h3>PowLU: An Activation Function for Stable Pre-Training of LLMs</h3>
  <p>该论文指出 SwiGLU 在大正输入下接近二次放大会扩大输出范围并加剧 outlier，从而在低精度大规模 LLM 预训练中带来数值不稳定。论文提出 Power Linear Unit (PowLU)，用有理幂函数在保持自适应非线性的同时稳定 spike 区域，并通过 scaling law 与 Ling 模型实验展示竞争性效果和更好的训练可扩展性。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25704" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
  </div>
</article>

<section class="paper-section" id="distillation">
  <div class="section-heading compact">
    <p class="eyebrow">1 篇论文</p>
    <h2>蒸馏</h2>
  </div>
  <div class="paper-grid">
<article class="paper-card" id="knowledge-distillation-of-large-language-models">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2023.06</span>
    <span>蒸馏</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models</h3>
  <p>该论文研究面向生成式大语言模型的白盒知识蒸馏，并提出 MiniLLM，用反向 KLD 替代标准前向 KLD，以避免学生模型高估教师分布中的低概率区域。论文推导了有效优化方法，并在 120M 到 13B 参数的不同模型族上提升指令跟随质量、校准性、曝光偏差和长文本生成表现。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.08543" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
